summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PropertyCheck AI Batch 4 UI/UX fixes. All major features working correctly: Building2 icon across all pages, legal pages (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, DPDP Compliance), Profile page with editable fields, Settings page with theme options, Search page with Sample - Review Only badge, Pricing page with 3 plans, Smart Search fallback to sample data, Bengaluru spelling in sample properties.

integration_issues.issue: Some older properties in search results show 'Bangalore Urban' instead of 'Bengaluru Urban'. This appears to be pre-existing data in the database not updated by re-seeding.

issues: Risk score thresholds differ between pages: UniversalSearch uses >=75 for VERIFIED, Dashboard uses >=80 for 'No Risk'. Requirement specified >=80 for No Risk, <80 for High Risk. Both implementations are consistent within their own pages.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Align risk score thresholds - UniversalSearch uses >=75 for GREEN/VERIFIED, but user request was >=80 for 'No Risk'. Consider updating backend logic at line 1285 to use >= 80.
MINOR: View Sample Registry button at bottom of search page was not found with data-testid selector. May need to add data-testid='view-sample-registry-btn' if this button exists.
